assets.title: English National Curriculum
assets.copy: Teaching combines the English National Curriculum with the International Primary Curriculum in Primary and the International Middle Years Curriculum in Middle School. Project-based lessons connect subjects and give children opportunities to explore ideas in the classroom and outdoors.
assets.alt: Children working together around a classroom table

assets.title: Small Class Sizes
assets.copy: With a maximum of 15 students per class, teachers can give each child individual attention and adapt learning to their needs. Mixed-age groups also give children opportunities to learn from one another, while progressing at their own pace.
assets.alt: A teacher guiding a child during a classroom activity

assets.title: International Education
assets.copy: Children learn in English, with French taught to both native speakers and those learning it as a new language. This sits alongside an international curriculum and a multicultural school environment, bringing different languages and perspectives into their education.
assets.alt: Flags from different countries in the school introduction film

assets.title: Modern Facilities
assets.copy: Classrooms have interactive whiteboards and computers, alongside a library with books in English, French and Dutch. A covered heated swimming pool, gardens and access to the forest provide spaces for reading, practical learning and physical activity.
assets.alt: The covered swimming pool at Forest

assets.title: International Community
assets.copy: Local and expatriate families bring different languages, cultures and experiences to school life. Children learn alongside classmates from a range of backgrounds, making the school community part of their everyday experience of an international education.
assets.alt: Children taking part in a shared classroom activity
